note: Twin Lakes Campground in Crimson Lake Provincial Park, about 15 km NW of Rocky Mountain House off Hwy 756: Loop A is treed and private, Loop B more open. Showers, coin laundry and the sani-dump are at the main Crimson Lake Campground a short drive away. Sites suit small-to-medium rigs: 17 of the 37 are 23 ft or longer, all but one in Loop A. The boardwalk to Twin Lakes Island was removed in August 2026 (replacement planned). --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page, shop and tear sheet: 37 unserviced reservable sites at C$31 (count 39 -> 37), vault toilets, non-potable pump, no dump on site; season May 13 - Sep 21 replaces the approximate May-Oct 15; reservation-only in season; max 41 ft, 2 pull-throughs; 20 of 37 sites are under 23 ft. Not waterfront kept; pin within ~110 m.

The Oct 9 advisory's reopening line reads 'May 19th, 2026' (a typo for 2027, the Crimson Lake advisory says May 19th, 2027) - the 2027 Twin Lakes opening is therefore unconfirmed.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - confirmed): Loop A sits in spruce 60-100 m west/northwest of the lake (the pin is at the shore pier); Loop B is north of the lake road, 50-80 m from the shore with the road and trees between. The shop tags only the Twin Lakes Group site 'Near Water'.
PIN (52.41520,-115.00520): at the lake edge by the pier, ~110 m SE of Loop A's centre - within tolerance.
